# Nayuki QR Code generator 1.8.0

Vendored unmodified ES6 browser build, distributed under the MIT License. Full copyright and license notice is included at the top of `gateway/gw/remote/qrcodegen.js`.

- Project: https://www.nayuki.io/page/qr-code-generator-library
- Release: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/releases/tag/v1.8.0
- Source asset: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/releases/download/v1.8.0/qrcodegen-v1.8.0-es6.js
- SHA-256: `6a1116192ed1dd67fa1bf31e77f5817103d71c23bbac24c382e698b7668bdd01`

The remote settings HTML embeds this local file when served, retaining the existing inline-only Content Security Policy. QR generation runs on demand in the browser without external requests. The encoder adds 45,336 bytes to the runtime payload; no npm or native dependency is required.
